_readme: CMS fixes verified against data/fda-full-2026-07-28.json on 4 Aug 2026 but NOT YET WRITTEN — the Framer plugin was disconnected.
Execution rules (learned the hard way this session):
1. collection fEfKTjIH1; pass draft:false explicitly on every call.

2. Where refs is null below: getCMSItems the item first, map its returned ref SLUGS to item IDs via data/diet-tag-ids.json (+ macro tags high-protein=GXhwlNe6a, low-carb=KRkFuSkGa, glp-1-friendly=gqeMXoOs9), and resend them in the same fieldData — a partial upsert revalidates the existing multi-ref and slugs fail validation.
3. Where refs is an array: write exactly that array (it is an intentional change).
4. Verify each write by read-back. CMS content goes live on the next Framer site publish.
Field IDs: allergens=ivojcMHVr, FaqQ1=zG08650jR, FaqA1=loB8_cYxl, FaqQ2=im_35WFB0, FaqA2=lrC33foKY, DietaryTags=IzMEvuZ8B.

fixes.title: Power Bowl
fixes.why: Measured recipe (Power Bowl - Regular row) contains NO chicken — vegetarian as served, worker v8's chicken dietNote was wrong. 680 cal > 650 so not GLP-1; 42g protein so High Protein stands.

fields.loB8_cYxl: Yes — as served it's vegetarian: beans, cheddar, avocado, romaine and salsas, no meat in the build. The 680-calorie figure is measured that way, with a brown rice base. Add grilled chicken or another protein if you'd like — that raises the numbers from there.

fixes.title: Spicy Slaw
fixes.why: FAQ said dressing 'may contain dairy'; the analysis says Soy only — no milk. Honey is why it's vegetarian, not vegan.

fields.lrC33foKY: No dairy in it — per our official allergen analysis the jalapeño-cilantro vinaigrette contains no milk, and the slaw is gluten-free too. It is made with honey, though, so we list it as vegetarian rather than vegan.

fixes.title: Caesar Wrap
fixes.why: Allergens field missing Wheat (flour tortilla; worker v8 carries it). 'Made fresh in-house daily' is the same unverifiable claim removed from Caesar Bowl; the dressing's fish matters in a wrap.

fields.loB8_cYxl: Our Caesar is a traditional-style dressing — it contains milk, eggs, fish (anchovy) and soy. With the flour tortilla this wrap also contains wheat; the Caesar Lettuce Wrap on romaine skips the tortilla.

fixes.title: Chicken Tex Mex Egg Roll
fixes.why: 'House-made' unverifiable; buffalo sauce is yogurt-ranch based (Milk, Eggs per the modifier rows) and that belongs in the answer.

fields.loB8_cYxl: Served with our creamy buffalo sauce — it's yogurt-ranch based, so it contains milk and eggs. Ask for it without if you're avoiding dairy.

fixes.title: Breakfast Bowl
fixes.why: Gluten-free-tagged while served with a wheat tortilla on the side and offering wheat-breaded proteins; neither FAQ carried a caveat.

fields.loB8_cYxl: Yes — choose from our full protein lineup to top your eggs. If you're avoiding gluten, note that crispy chicken and breaded plant based chicken are breaded with wheat; every other protein is wheat-free.
fields.lrC33foKY: Yes, a tortilla is served on the side if you'd like to wrap it up. It contains wheat — the bowl itself is made without gluten-containing ingredients, so set the tortilla aside if gluten matters for you.

fixes.title: Fajita Bowl
fixes.why: My own 4 Aug fix listed 4 bases; the export's Bases - Regular Bowls group has 6, one of which (whole wheat linguine) contains wheat + eggs. And the bowl is served with a warm tortilla or chips (wheat) its lab row doesn't include.

fields.loB8_cYxl: Your choice of base: brown rice, jasmine rice, quinoa, cauliflower rice, spiraled veggies, or whole wheat linguine. All are made without gluten-containing ingredients except the linguine (wheat, eggs). The bowl is served with a warm tortilla or chips, which contain wheat — ask for yours without if you're avoiding gluten. Nutrition shown is measured with one standard build, so calories shift with your picks.

fixes.title: Original Crispy Treat
fixes.why: FAQ said only 'made with common allergens on-site' while the data names milk, barley-malt gluten, and gelatin (not vegetarian).

fields.loB8_cYxl: Yes — it contains milk, and its cereal contains malt extract made from barley, so it isn't gluten-free even though it has no wheat. The marshmallow also contains gelatin, so it isn't vegetarian. Please tell a manager about any food allergy before ordering.

fixes.title: Chocolate Crispy Treat
fixes.why: Same disclosure, plus soy from the chocolate.

fields.loB8_cYxl: Same crispy rice and marshmallow base, topped with chocolate chips. Like the Original it contains milk and barley-malt gluten, plus soy in the chocolate — and the marshmallow contains gelatin, so it isn't vegetarian.

fixes.title: Kid's Crunchy Chicken Meal
fixes.why: Item allergens (Soy, Wheat) cover the chicken only; the carrots & ranch side it 'comes with' adds Milk + Eggs (yogurt ranch).

fields.ivojcMHVr: Soy, Wheat (carrots & ranch side adds Milk, Eggs)
fields.loB8_cYxl: Crispy crunchy chicken served with a side of carrots and ranch. The ranch is yogurt-based, so the side adds milk and eggs — steamed carrots or steamed broccoli are the allergen-free side swaps.

fixes.title: Kid's Cheese Quesadilla
fixes.why: Same side gap: quesadilla row is Milk/Wheat/Soy; the ranch side adds Eggs.

fields.ivojcMHVr: Milk, Wheat, Soy (carrots & ranch side adds Eggs)
fields.loB8_cYxl: A cheese quesadilla served with a side of carrots and ranch. The ranch is yogurt-based and adds eggs — steamed carrots or steamed broccoli are the allergen-free side swaps.
